The Whisper of Shadow

CHARACTERS
Simba (Cub) – curious, ego starting to grow

Nala (Cub) – brave, playful, questions things

Zazu-like Advisor – comic + responsible

Scar-like Antagonist – calm, dangerous, manipulative


PURPOSE OF SCENE
Introduce villain energy

Show Simba’s naivety + pride

Plant idea of forbidden land as “adventure”

Start psychological manipulation


Simba and Nala chase each other through tall grass . nala said “ you’re too slow!” then simba replied “I am letting you win!”

The entry of the villain


villain :
That is absolutely not how monarchy works—
Suddenly.
The wind… stops.
villain

A voice—smooth, almost amused.
SCAR (O.S.):
Well… isn’t that an interesting interpretation.
They turn.
From behind a rock formation, SCAR emerges slowly.
Lean. Calm. Eyes sharp.
Not loud. Not aggressive. Just… controlled.
Zazu stiffens instantly.
ZAZU (nervous):
Your… uh… uncle.
Simba’s expression shifts—half excitement, half caution.
